discoverabilityFindings.evidence: Official GitHub documentation supports useful README content, descriptive topics and profile links. Google documentation supports visible helpful content and standard crawl/index eligibility for both ordinary and AI search.
discoverabilityFindings.inference: Clear category wording, genuine product evidence, practical setup and specific country-source pages are sensible discovery and onboarding choices. The reviewed projects do not establish their causal effect on Tawdheef's performance.
discoverabilityFindings.limits: No measured ranking, indexing, AI citation, downloads, conversions or production adoption is established. No first, best, complete, guaranteed-free-provider or automatic-search-inclusion claim is supported.
maintainerControlsRecommended: Enable and verify private vulnerability reporting when the public repository exists.
Enable dependency alerts and review Dependabot updates for npm and GitHub Actions.
Require relevant passing checks on the main branch and review public source/data changes; use review rules appropriate for a personal maintainer.
Keep PR workflow tokens read-only; do not run untrusted PR code with privileged pull_request_target or release credentials.
Use hosted isolated fixture tests, never the maintainer's private tracker, CV, mailbox, credentials or account sign-ins in public CI.
Keep write permissions limited to the reviewed release job and review action dependencies; consider verified SHA pinning or supported workflow dependency locking.
Treat policies, scans and branch controls as risk reduction rather than legal immunity, security certification or control over independent forks.
